pages.raw_meta: Empower your healthcare strategy with AMN’s full-spectrum tech-enabled talent solutions from contingent staffing to virtual care management.
raw_blocks: Your Workforce Partner in the Mission of Care
Offering proven talent strategies, end-to-end staffing solutions, and integrated technology—from self-service to fully managed options—tailored for a high-quality, cost-effective workforce.
One Technology Suite to Maximize Workforce Efficiency
WorkWise™ is designed for the healthcare industry, enabling organizations to boost efficiency and optimize outcomes, with an all-in-one technology.
81% Reduction in Nurse Staffing Spend
Nursing healthcare providers have experienced an 81% decrease in labor expenses using AI-powered workforce planning.
Plan Strategically, Acquire Efficiently, Deploy Seamlessly with WorkWise.
Key Components of a Successful, Strategic Partnership
We provide the full spectrum of clinical and nonclinical professionals, from Nursing to Allied, International, Leadership, Locums, and beyond for travel, temp-to-hire, per diem, and permanent.
We deliver transparent billing, market rate data, competitive suppliers, and flexible staffing models designed to efficiently meet your needs while driving cost savings.

Our all-in-one technology, WorkWise, can be the engine of your program, transforming staffing and workforce management to reduce costs, boost staff satisfaction, and deliver unparalleled workforce and market insights.

Our healthcare-specific vendor technology is SOC 2 certified, engages in Rapid7 Penetration Testing, and Managed Detection and Response (MDR) – meeting the highest security and testing standards in the industry.
AMN Healthcare’s tech trio powers smarter staffing, faster planning, and seamless clinician connection.
Trusted Partners Powered by Our Technology
Workforce Solutions for Leaders Like You
Managing Labor Costs and Driving Efficiency
Empowering CHROs For Future Workforce

AMN Healthcare provides the full spectrum of clinical and nonclinical professionals, including nursing , allied health , international, leadership , locums , and revenue cycle specialists , available for travel, temp-to-hire, per diem , and permanent placements .

AMN Healthcare offers end-to-end staffing solutions , integrated workforce technology , and strategic consulting services , with options ranging from self-service to fully managed programs tailored for cost-effective, high-quality workforce outcomes.

AMN Healthcare's technology helps health systems lower staffing costs through smarter workforce planning, faster hiring, and better staffing utilization. By improving visibility and automating key processes, organizations can reduce labor expenses, fill roles more efficiently, and deliver more consistent patient care.

AMN Healthcare's technology is SOC 2 certified, undergoes Rapid7 Penetration Testing, and uses a Managed Detection and Response (MDR) platform, meeting the highest security and testing standards in the healthcare industry.

Yes, AMN Healthcare's advisory services include labor model redesign, retention and engagement optimization, and predictive workforce planning, with experts working directly alongside organizational leadership to drive long-term success.

AMN Healthcare offers tailored workforce solutions for Chief Nursing Officers, Chief Financial Officers, and Chief Human Resources Officers, addressing challenges such as labor costs, workforce sustainability, and operational efficiency.
Develop a more balanced workforce by leveraging technology, advanced strategies, and analytics to increase efficiency, reduce costs, and improve patient and provider experiences.

raw_blocks: At AMN we embrace the ways we are similar and different, respecting all voices and ensuring everyone has the opportunity to contribute to our collective success. We acknowledge our shared responsibility to foster a welcoming environment where everyone feels recognized and valued.

We cast a wide net to recruit and retain competitive talent and build healthcare workforces supportive of the communities we serve. We believe in the power of compassion and collaboration to build healthy communities where access to quality care is available to all.
Our Mission To empower the future of care by serving as the trusted, innovative workforce partner to healthcare organizations and professionals nationwide.

Our Vision To be healthcare’s total talent workforce partner, providing the people and technology platform to help build a sustainable and adaptable workforce across all models, connecting more clinicians to care.
We foster an environment where all individuals are respected, valued, and empowered to reach their fullest potential.
By embracing diverse experiences and perspectives, we ensure every voice is heard and appreciated.
We recruit world-class talent across both our corporate and clinical workforce, recognizing their crucial roles in the mission of care.
Our corporate team exemplifies compassion, innovation, and grit, delivering white glove service in unwavering support of clients and clinicians.
Our clinicians bring this mission to life by providing compassionate, high-quality care to patients whenever and wherever they are needed.
Together, we uphold a steadfast commitment to exceptional healthcare access for all, meeting the high standards expected by clients and healthcare professionals.
The Values We Stand By
What It’s Like Being Part of AMN Healthcare

We prioritize supporting, engaging, and developing our team members to help them thrive. Through our Performance Success Plans, we provide feedback, annual reviews, and personalized development plans aligned with career goals. We further encourage growth with education assistance and our Learning Lounge of micro-learning courses. To foster connection, we host CEO presentations, executive roundtables, and events like town halls and celebrations, ensuring every voice is heard and everyone feels inspired to contribute to our shared success.

Being a part of AMN is an opportunity to fulfill your personal and professional goals while making a difference in the healthcare community. We celebrate our team members and support what drives them, recharges them, and makes them whole. Whether that is through a flexible schedule, an employee resource group, or just the encouragement from a manager to take time off, AMN values its team members beyond all else.

Our Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) are vibrant, team-member led communities. Open to all, ERGs are bring people together through shared interests and experiences. These groups foster a deep sense of belonging, providing a welcoming space for open dialogue, meaningful connections, and development opportunities, uniting team members from across the company to build stronger bonds and collaboration.
We don’t just hire people we invest in them with strategic initiatives to help them thrive and reach their career goals and full potential.
When we invest in the leaders of tomorrow, everyone wins. Our team members have access to financial resources to help them achieve educational goals.
Team members are encouraged to grow within the organization, whether it be in similar roles, different departments, or on a leadership track.
Fostering Resilience in the Healthcare Workforce and The Teams Supporting Them

Through meaningful and concrete recognition, we honor the vital contributions of healthcare professionals and the dedicated teams who support them. Together, their unwavering commitment, compassion, and life-changing impact enrich the lives of individuals and strengthen entire communities.

Through our Caring for Caregivers initiative, AMN Healthcare provides a grant program for our caregivers. The program helps alleviate the stresses that come with life-changing events. With grants of up to $5,000 for a variety of life’s setbacks, we’re letting you know that we appreciate the efforts you’ve made working for the company.

Our counterpart program for team members, the AMN Hardship Assistance Fund supports those who are experiencing a catastrophic and unexpected hardship that causes undue financial stress. The program allows AMN regular team members experiencing a qualifying event, such as serious or life-threatening illnesses, natural disasters, death or victim of domestic abuse, to apply for non-taxable grant assistance of up to $5,000.

Our deep commitment to empowering healthcare professionals and their teams goes beyond financial support, fostering development programs, offering educational opportunities, and providing fulfilling career paths, ensuring they can thrive while supporting the mission of care.

Our healthcare professionals, team members and their families also have access to our Employee Assistance program , which provides resources for healthcare, mental health, financial health and other support.
Making a Positive Impact in Our Communities
We strengthen communities by partnering with proven organizations that support our clients, healthcare professionals, and health-related needs. The impact of AMN extends across multiple areas:
Creating employment opportunities for thousands of team members
Providing meaningful career pathways for healthcare professionals
Generating direct and ripple economic impact by partnering with small businesses
Leveraging our innovative technology and talent solutions to improve healthcare access
Enhancing care for millions of patients through our Language Services interpreters
Supporting better health outcomes for millions by placing quality healthcare professionals in their communities
Responsible Giving that Makes a Difference
At the heart of our mission is the goal to positively impact health and wellness for all. Through active community engagement and responsible giving, we make a meaningful difference through:
Whether you’re a healthcare professional, client organization, or community partner, we’d love to hear from you. Tell us how we can help.”
